title: Collect the analytics that cannot be recovered later
objective: Write down the questions the business needs answered, decide which of them are unanswerable if nobody records now, and record exactly those. Founder's instruction, 2026-08-08, in place of an analytics epic.
acceptance_criteria: docs/product/business-questions.md exists and states, per question, whether it is answerable and from what
the discovery events reach analytics_events for a signed-out Customer — proven by a pgTAP case seen to fail first
SearchPerformed carries what Kafoo chose (top_cuisine, top_category, area_narrowed) and never a word a Customer said
MealOpened exists on both surfaces, emitted from the shared card, carrying source, cuisine and category
no event carries the phrase, the area, a Meal id, or an exclusion — asserted by test on both surfaces
event-model.md registry updated in the same change
notes:
SHARES A BRANCH WITH WP-018 ON PURPOSE, and that is the exception rather than the pattern. Both edit apps/web/lib/discovery.ts and apps/web/app/, WP-018 is not merged, and two branches over the same unmerged files is a guaranteed conflict for no gain. The coordinator's call, recorded here so the next session does not read one branch carrying two packages as a mistake.

WHAT THIS FOUND, and it is bigger than what it built: the anon insert policy on analytics_events allowed two E1 sign-in event names and nothing else, so every discovery event emitted by a signed-out Customer had been rejected with 42501 and swallowed since E3 shipped. Both surfaces, silently, with the gate green throughout — emitEvent catches everything by design, and analytics_events_rls_test case 3 asserted the old behaviour correctly. E3 recorded no searches at all for the case E3 was built for.

DELEGATION SUSPENDED 2026-08-06 by the founder. Written directly. Nothing was dispatched, so nothing was spent — the validator requires a positive envelope, so it carries the figure this work WOULD take if delegation resumes rather than a record of spend. suggested_model is the row it would go to — auth and a privacy boundary, which is the expensive row's actual purpose.
